TI_recommendation.section: 8.2.2.2, Equation 5, printed p12; required for adjustable versions in section 8.2.2.5 p14
TI_recommendation.example_120pF_context: 100 kΩ lower divider resistor, not this circuit
TI_recommendation.tolerance_limit_for_Cff: No explicit Cff tolerance acceptance window stated in cited TI section; ±5% selected part remains an engineering candidate pending loop validation.

derived_capacitance_ranges_pF.derivation: Cnom*(1±0.05)*(1±30e-6*abs(T-25)); drift multiplied against initial tolerance, not a guarantee of regulator stability.

conditions_and_holds: Use density B geometry in footprint-geometry.json for a provisional, source-backed footprint; no CAD files were edited by this review.
Keep all four capacitor/divider/FB nets as recorded in reference-map.json; part is nonpolar.
Capacitor operating temperature must remain at or below 125°C. Provisional 85°C enclosure air leaves a numerical 40°C difference, not measured board or component thermal margin.

50 V is DC working rating. The 125 V withstand test rating is not a working-voltage allowance. Actual DC plus ripple/transients across the part must satisfy working limits; only nominal divider DC voltages are evaluated here.
C0G manufacturer description supports stable capacitance versus voltage/time; no X7R substitution or blanket 85°C-rated substitution is authorized by this contract.
Confirm ±5% Cff and resistor tolerances together with actual regulator, inductor, effective output capacitance, load and layout in transient/loop verification.
Assembler must approve mask, paste, stencil and mounting process. 0402 is reflow-only in manufacturer recommendations.
Place sense network near regulator and sense output at output capacitor; protect FB trace from SW coupling per TI section 8.4.1 p22.
38×38 mm / six-layer / top-only fit, full-board thermal performance, routing, EMI and production DFM are outside this conditional source review.
Procurement stock observations are snapshots; LCSC MOQ20 exception and independent JLC assembly availability are unresolved preferences/verification.
release_scope: Not loop stability qualification, rail-accuracy qualification, thermal validation, procurement authorization, or fabrication release.
